brief:
Israeli military forces have conducted a new incursion into the countryside surrounding Syria's Quneitra province, the Shehab Wire reported. The operation included the establishment of a checkpoint in the area, marking a fresh advance by Israeli troops in the strategically sensitive border region.

The deployment follows a pattern of Israeli military activity in the Syrian Golan Heights. Israeli forces have maintained a presence in portions of the territory since 1967, with periodic expansions of their footprint. The checkpoint's specific operational purpose and the full scope of the latest deployment remained unclear as of reporting.
